name: CommsOn
summary:
“Why aren’t you replying?” “Sorry… I’m playing VR.”

Read and reply to iPhone texts in a movable Quest window alongside supported games and apps. Keep your headset on and stay reachable.

• Floating alerts and a bell announce incoming texts.
• Find conversations and contacts in a compact menu.
• Do Not Disturb silences alerts; messages still arrive.
• Explore CommsOn explains the controls and Quest keyboard dictation.
• Connect your nearby iPhone over Bluetooth. No laptop or companion phone app needed.
